entries.speaker: Gian-Carlo Rota
entries.quote: One example is quantum mechanics, which was discovered 30 years ago. The mathematics behind quantum mechanics had been worked out 20 years before by a mathematician who didn't know what it was good for.
entries.work: “Rota reflects on math and mathematicians,” interview by Denise Brehm, MIT News Office
entries.locus: answer to the question “What sorts of problems have combinatorics solved in the past?”
